title: With De'Zhaun Stribling out 10 weeks, 49ers must adapt their passing game

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: With De'Zhaun Stribling out 10 weeks, 49ers must adapt their passing game
sources.description: The loss of De'Zhaun Stribling might not sink the 49ers' offense, but it could present some limitations until he returns much farther down the line.
